keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row). The page: Philip II received about an eighth of his father's territories, 'mainly the former Lower County of Katzenelnbogen': on the left bank of the Rhine the Amt of Rheinfels with St. Goar, on the right bank Braubach, Reichenberg and Hohenstein. No area. A 14 km circle at St. Goar (7.71E 50.15N, about 615 km2, the circle landgraviate-of-hesse-kassel uses for its 1583 gain) is a soft stand-in; the right-bank places lie at the edge of it. Revised after review: the 14 km St. Goar circle (about 760 km2 on the gazetteer grid) missed the right-bank Ämter the page names, so a 15 km circle at 7.85E 50.22N (Braubach, Reichenberg, Hohenstein) is joined to it (union about 1,010 km2 on the grid). The page gives no area, only 'about an eighth of his father's territories', and no total for the old Landgraviate, so the area ratio cannot be computed from the pages; against the reviewer's figure of about 2,700 km2 for an eighth the shape is still short, and I leave it because no page supports that figure (the Lower County of Katzenelnbogen with its four Ämter is the page's 'mainly'). Hesse-Kassel's 1583 gain still draws the single St. Goar circle; that dossier was not touched in this repair and should take the same union.

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 for batch eu-09-x (1 page of its own plus the Kassel page already read for landgraviate-of-hesse-kassel; budget 1-2). New state: no Cliopatria row.

SCOPE. 1567 to 1583 (Philip II's reign as given on the Rheinfels page; the Kassel page footnote gives the line's end in 1583 and the sharing). The page's later 'Hesse-Rheinfels' for Ernest (landgrave 1627-1658, Rheinfels and the lower county of Katzenelnbogen as inheritance of Maurice's younger sons, with Eschwege, Rotenburg and Wanfried added after 1655/1658) and 'Hesse-Rheinfels-Rotenburg', which 'survived till 1834', are cadet apanages inside Hesse-Kassel, not sovereign states in the sense of this atlas; the page gives no dates for their land changes, so no events are entered. Hesse-Rotenburg, Hesse-Eschwege and Hesse-Wanfried are not dossiers.

SHAPE. Same 14 km circle as the Kassel gain (7.71E 50.15N). The Amt of Rheinfels on the left bank and Braubach, Reichenberg and Hohenstein on the right bank are named; the lower county of Katzenelnbogen is larger than the circle. No area, no capital on the page. Gazetteer names wanted: 'St. Goar', 'Braubach', 'Rheinfels'.

NOT SETTLED. (1) No month for 1567 or 1583; (2) the page gives no division of 1583 (the Kassel footnote says three-way, the Landgraviate of Hesse page says Kassel); (3) the three-way sharing between Kassel, Marburg and Darmstadt is not drawn.

COUNTERPARTS NEEDING DOSSIERS: none new.

REVISION 2026-10-25 (after review). The shape is now the St. Goar circle (7.71E 50.15N, 14 km) joined to a right-bank circle at 7.85E 50.22N, 15 km, for Braubach, Reichenberg and Hohenstein (found event, keyframe, dissolve, predecessor and successor lands all changed). AREA: the page gives only 'about an eighth of his father's territories' and no figure; the reviewer's 2,700 km2 for an eighth is not on the page, so the ratio 0.29 is not confirmed and the shape stays near 1,010 km2 on the grid. NOT DONE: landgraviate-of-hesse-kassel (verdict fix, not touched in this run) still draws the single 14 km circle for its 1583 gain from this state and should take the same union; its event and this dossier's dissolve now differ. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Braubach', 'Reichenberg (St. Goarshausen)', 'Hohenstein (Taunus)'.
